parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of duplicate options in formfields when using limit_choices_to with a Q object. The change is minimal and focused on the problem area.

issues.description: The patch introduces an import statement for `Exists`, `OuterRef`, and `Q` which could be moved to the top of the file for better maintainability.
The patch uses `Exists` and `OuterRef` which might not be consistent with the existing coding style in the file.
